name: Vercel Hobby
free_limit: 100 GB Fast Data Transfer; included serverless functions
watch_out: Hobby is restricted to personal, non-commercial projects; usage caps pause services.

name: Netlify Free
free_limit: 300 credits/month on new credit-based plans; custom domains and SSL
watch_out: Production deploys, requests, bandwidth and compute all consume credits; legacy accounts may differ.

name: Cloudflare Pages
free_limit: 500 builds/month; up to 20,000 files/site on Free
watch_out: Pages Functions consume the separate Workers quota; 20-minute build timeout.

name: GitHub Pages
free_limit: Static sites from public repositories; 1 GB site limit; ~100 GB/month soft bandwidth
watch_out: Not permitted as free hosting for an online business, e-commerce site or commercial SaaS.

name: Firebase Hosting (Spark)
free_limit: 10 GB stored; 360 MB/day transferred; custom domain and SSL
watch_out: Firebase App Hosting is a different product and is not available on Spark.

name: Azure Static Web Apps Free
free_limit: 100 GB bandwidth per subscription; 2 custom domains/app
watch_out: Intended for hobby/personal apps; site becomes unavailable after exceeding bandwidth quota.

name: Render Static Sites
free_limit: Free static-site deployments with automatic TLS
watch_out: Outbound bandwidth and build minutes share workspace quotas; excess usage may be billable.

name: Deplexo Free Hosting
free_limit: 1 always-on app; 0.25 CPU; 128 MB RAM; 250 MB disk
watch_out: Provider advertises no sleep; long-term reliability has not been independently verified.

name: Render Free Web Services
free_limit: 750 shared free instance hours/workspace/month
watch_out: Services sleep after inactivity; no persistent local disk. Not recommended for production.

name: Koyeb Free Web Instance
free_limit: One Free instance: 512 MB RAM, 0.1 vCPU, 2 GB SSD
watch_out: Limited regions; sleeps after an hour without traffic; no persistent volumes.

name: Railway Free
free_limit: $1 monthly credit after an initial up-to-30-day $5 trial
watch_out: Usage beyond recurring free credit requires checking billing and available resources.

name: Deno Deploy Free
free_limit: 1 million requests/month; 20 GiB egress/month; 5 custom domains
watch_out: Runtime, resource and team restrictions apply; inspect current deployment pricing.

name: Cloudflare Workers Free
free_limit: 100,000 requests/day; 10 ms CPU time per invocation
watch_out: Functions on Pages share this quota; not a general-purpose always-on server.

name: Google Cloud Run
free_limit: 2 million requests/month under eligible request-based billing
watch_out: A Cloud Billing account is required; builds, logging and network usage can incur charges.

name: Oracle Cloud Always Free Compute
free_limit: Eligible AMD and Arm Ampere A1 compute resources
watch_out: Requires a valid payment card for identity verification; region capacity and inactivity policies apply.

name: Google Compute Engine Free Tier
free_limit: One eligible e2-micro VM/month; 30 GB standard disk; 1 GB eligible egress
watch_out: Only selected US regions qualify; billing account required; other usage can be charged.

name: AWS Free Plan
free_limit: Eligible new accounts: up to six months or until Free Tier credits run out
watch_out: NOT an indefinite free VPS; different AWS offers have separate eligibility and limits.

name: Convex Free
free_limit: 0.5 GB database storage; 1M function calls/month; 1 GB file storage
watch_out: Separate database I/O, action compute, search and egress caps apply.

name: Supabase Free
free_limit: 500 MB Postgres database/project; 2 active projects; 1 GB file storage
watch_out: Free projects pause after one week of inactivity; restore/backups are limited.

name: Turso Free
free_limit: 100 databases; 5 GB storage; 500M rows read and 10M rows written/month
watch_out: Read/write usage and sync limits apply; re-check pricing before production use.

name: MongoDB Atlas Free Cluster
free_limit: 512 MB storage; one Free cluster per project
watch_out: Limited regions, throughput and cluster capabilities; designed for development.

name: Upstash Redis Free
free_limit: 256 MB data; 500,000 commands/month; 10 GB monthly bandwidth
watch_out: One Free database; claim temporary instant-created databases to prevent expiry.

name: Upstash Vector Free
free_limit: One free index; 10,000 queries and 10,000 updates/day; 1 GB data; up to 1,536 dimensions
watch_out: No uptime SLA; maximum 100 namespaces; daily query/update quotas apply.

name: Cloudflare D1 Free
free_limit: 5 GB total storage; 5M rows read/day; 100k rows written/day
watch_out: Daily limits stop queries on exhaustion; associated Workers usage has its own quota.

name: Cloudflare Hyperdrive Free
free_limit: 100,000 database queries/day; up to 10 configured databases
watch_out: Requires a separate PostgreSQL/MySQL origin and Workers; query quota resets at 00:00 UTC and excess queries fail; origin hosting may cost extra.

name: Cloudflare Vectorize Free
free_limit: 30M queried vector dimensions/month; 5M stored vector dimensions; up to 100 indexes
watch_out: Free plan queries and storage are dimension-based, not a fixed request count; up to 1,536 dimensions/vector and 1,000 namespaces/index. Workers usage has separate limits.

name: Render Free Postgres
free_limit: 1 GB database, one free instance/workspace
watch_out: Database EXPIRES after 30 days; not suitable for durable production data.

name: Firebase Realtime Database (Spark)
free_limit: 1 GB stored; ~10 GB/month downloaded; 100 concurrent connections
watch_out: Spark limits and feature eligibility vary; avoid assuming unlimited usage.

name: Cloudflare R2 Standard
free_limit: 10 GB-month storage; 1M Class A + 10M Class B operations/month
watch_out: Free allowance covers Standard class only; operations beyond limits incur charges.

name: Google Cloud Storage Free Tier
free_limit: 5 GB-months in eligible US regions; 5,000 Class A and 50,000 Class B operations
watch_out: Eligible regions only; Cloud Billing required; egress rules are destination-dependent.

name: Oracle Object Storage Always Free
free_limit: Always Free object-storage allowance on eligible OCI accounts
watch_out: Card verification required; quotas and capacity can vary by service and region.

name: PR Quorum Free
free_limit: 50 AI code reviews/month across 2 repositories; max 3 inline comments/review
watch_out: Default three-reviewer panel only; excess reviews are skipped until reset or upgrade.

name: Estuary Developer
free_limit: 10 GB data movement/month; 2 concurrent connector instances
watch_out: Exceeding free quotas automatically starts a 30-day Cloud trial.

name: Resend Free
free_limit: 3,000 transactional emails/month; 100/day; up to 3 domains
watch_out: Daily sending cap and deliverability/domain-verification requirements apply.

name: Better Stack Free
free_limit: 10 monitors/heartbeats; 1 status page
watch_out: Free personal-project tier; alert channels and log retention have limits.

name: GitHub Actions
free_limit: Standard GitHub-hosted runners free for public repos; 2,000 minutes/month on GitHub Free private repos
watch_out: Larger runners and over-quota private-repo usage may be billed.

name: Neon Free Postgres
free_limit: 100 projects; 100 CU-hours/project/month; 0.5 GB storage/project
watch_out: Scale-to-zero after inactivity; 5 GB public network transfer/project/month; verify project eligibility.

name: Cloudflare Workers KV Free
free_limit: 1 GB storage; 100k key reads/day; 1k key writes/day
watch_out: Writes, deletes and list requests each have a 1k/day cap; operations fail when daily quota is exhausted.

name: Brevo Free
free_limit: 300 email sends/day; up to 100k contacts
watch_out: Daily unused sends do not roll over; free emails carry Brevo branding; queues and transactional limits apply.

name: GitHub Codespaces (personal Free)
free_limit: 120 core-hours/month and 15 GB-month storage for GitHub Free personal accounts
watch_out: Organizations have no included Codespaces quota; 2-core machines use two core-hours per elapsed hour.

name: Cloudflare Email Routing
free_limit: Free inbound custom-domain email forwarding and routing on Free/Paid plans
watch_out: Not a free outbound transactional email API; Email Sending requires Workers Paid. Domain must use Cloudflare email routing.

name: GitHub Packages
free_limit: Public packages are free; GitHub Free includes 500 MB private storage and 1 GB monthly transfer
watch_out: Private quotas share storage with Actions artifacts; over-quota usage may be blocked or billed.

name: Doppler Developer
free_limit: 3 users free; 5 config syncs; 3 days of activity logs
watch_out: Additional users cost $8/month; advanced SSO and audit retention require paid plans.

name: Auth0 Free
free_limit: Up to 25,000 monthly active users; one custom domain and five organizations
watch_out: Credit card not required to sign up; custom-domain feature requires card verification; tenant and connection limits apply.

name: Clerk Hobby
free_limit: 50,000 monthly retained users per app; unlimited applications
watch_out: MRU is not equivalent to monthly active users; free plan has limited dashboard seats and short log retention.

name: Cloudflare Turnstile Free
free_limit: Up to 20 widgets/account; unlimited challenges; 10 hostnames/widget
watch_out: Free tier has 7-day analytics lookback; remove-branding and advanced controls are Enterprise-only.

name: New Relic Free
free_limit: 100 GB data ingest/month; 1 full-platform user; unlimited basic users; 500 synthetic checks; at least 8 days default retention
watch_out: When the 100 GB monthly free ingest allowance is exceeded, ingest and platform access stop until upgrade or next month; retention varies by data type.

name: UptimeRobot Free
free_limit: 50 monitors with 5-minute checks and basic status pages
watch_out: Longer monitoring intervals and limited alert integrations; faster 60-second checks require paid plan.

name: Grafana Cloud Free
free_limit: 10k active metric series and 50 GB logs ingested/month; 14-day retention
watch_out: Free quotas are separate for logs, metrics, traces and users; limited retention and community support.

name: Sentry Developer
free_limit: One user; 5,000 errors/month; 50 replays and 1 uptime monitor
watch_out: Free plan is single-user; profiling, advanced integrations and additional event volumes require payment.

name: Splunk Observability Cloud Free Edition
free_limit: Up to 15 hosts with all Observability Cloud platform features; no time limit
watch_out: May be throttled and accounts inactive for 30+ days can be deactivated; use is limited to internal business purposes and not service-bureau processing for third parties.

name: Tinybird Free
free_limit: 10 GB storage; 1,000 requests/day per organization; 0.25 vCPU (up to 3x burst); 1 query thread
watch_out: Shared infrastructure; CPU bursts beyond capacity return HTTP 429; Free queries have a 10-second execution limit; $25 LLM credits per billing cycle are separate.

name: PostHog Free
free_limit: 1M product analytics events/month; 5k session recordings/month; 1M feature flag requests
watch_out: Free without a card for one project; usage stops at limits unless billing is enabled.

name: Cloudflare DNS & CDN Free
free_limit: Free authoritative DNS, CDN, universal SSL and DDoS protection
watch_out: Free DNS zones created since Sep 2024 default to 200 records; free CDN is not a substitute for hosting.

name: Hugging Face Static Spaces
free_limit: Free static Spaces for ML demo frontends and project showcases
watch_out: Creating Gradio or Docker compute Spaces requires a paid plan; static hosting does not provide free persistent compute.

name: Google Gemini Developer API Free
free_limit: Free input and output tokens for eligible Gemini models; Google AI Studio access
watch_out: Free API eligibility and rate limits vary by model and region; free-tier content can be used to improve Google products.

name: Cloudflare Workers AI Free
free_limit: 10,000 Neurons/day across eligible inference models; resets at 00:00 UTC
watch_out: Neuron consumption varies by model; selected models require Workers Paid or prepaid credits. Free allocation stops when exhausted; Workers limits apply separately.

name: Aiven Free PostgreSQL
free_limit: One PostgreSQL service: 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 1 GB disk
watch_out: No VPC, static IP, pooling or SLA; 20 max connections; inactive services can be powered off.

name: Appwrite Cloud Free
free_limit: 2 projects; 5 GB monthly bandwidth; 2 GB storage; 750K executions/month; 75K MAU
watch_out: Free projects pause after one week of inactivity; 1 database, 1 bucket and 2 functions per project.

name: GitLab CI/CD Free
free_limit: 400 compute minutes/month per GitLab.com Free namespace on hosted instance runners
watch_out: Runner cost factors vary; quota is shared across the namespace; extra compute minutes may need purchase.

name: Cloudflare Queues Free
free_limit: 10,000 read/write/delete operations/day on Workers Free; 24-hour retention
watch_out: Typical delivery uses three operations per message; retries add reads and Free retention is fixed.

name: Upstash QStash Free
free_limit: 1,000 message delivery attempts/day; 50 GB monthly bandwidth; 10 schedules
watch_out: Retries and topic subscribers count as additional deliveries; 1 MB message size and seven-day max delay.

name: Upstash Workflow Free
free_limit: 1,000 workflow steps/day; 50 GB monthly bandwidth; up to 10 concurrent steps
watch_out: Retries consume extra steps; 1 MB message size and seven-day maximum sleep.

name: cron-job.org Free
free_limit: Free scheduled HTTP requests as frequently as every minute; no fixed job-count limit under fair use
watch_out: Fair-use requirements apply; REST API is limited to 100 calls/day by default and jobs call public URLs.

name: Cloudflare Workflows Free
free_limit: 3,000 workflow steps/day and 1 GB-month state storage; request quota shared with Workers Free
watch_out: 10 ms CPU per invocation on Free; default instance-state retention is three days.

name: TinyFish Search & Fetch
free_limit: Search: 30 requests/min and 500/hour; Fetch: 150 URLs/min and 1,000/day
watch_out: Agent and Browser are separately metered; Search/Fetch stay free with $0 Wallet.

name: Algolia Free Search
free_limit: 10K searches/month; 50K records; 5K recommendation requests and 5K crawls/month
watch_out: Higher usage and advanced search require paid plans; track record and request quotas separately.

name: Upstash Search Free
free_limit: One free search database; 20K monthly queries; maximum 200K documents
watch_out: Query and indexed-document caps apply independently; higher volumes need a paid usage plan.

name: Flagsmith Free
free_limit: 50,000 flag API requests/month; one team member and one project; unlimited feature flags
watch_out: Fair-use limits apply; multi-user administration, advanced scheduling and experimentation need paid plans.

name: LaunchDarkly Developer
free_limit: Unlimited seats and feature flags; five service connections; 1,000 client-side MAU/month
watch_out: Client MAU and service connections have separate caps; higher-scale rollout capabilities use paid plans.

name: Upstash Blob Free
free_limit: 1 GB average storage/month; 10 GB bandwidth, 10,000 simple and 2,000 advanced operations/month
watch_out: Free bucket stops serving requests when any quota is exhausted until its 30-day window resets; multipart uploads count as advanced operations.

name: Weaviate Cloud Free
free_limit: One cluster/user; 100,000 objects, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB disk; 2,000 embedding requests/day and 1,000 Query Agent requests/month
watch_out: One collection and up to three tenants; limited AWS regions, no backups or HA, best-effort availability.

name: Inngest Hobby
free_limit: 50,000 executions and 500,000 events/month; 5 concurrent steps; 3 users and 3 workers
watch_out: An execution counts each function run plus its steps; free execution pauses on quota exhaustion; 24-hour trace retention and 7-day maximum sleep.

name: Trigger.dev Free
free_limit: $5 recurring monthly compute/run credits; 20 concurrent runs; unlimited tasks; 10 schedules
watch_out: Free credit covers metered compute and run invocation; execution stops or queues after credits run out until upgrade; 1-day log retention.

name: Qdrant Cloud Free
free_limit: One single-node cluster with 0.5 vCPU, 1 GB RAM and 4 GB disk
watch_out: For testing and prototypes; limited regions, no high availability; suspends after 1 week of inactivity and deletes after 4 weeks unless reactivated.

name: Cloudflare Durable Objects Free
free_limit: 100,000 Durable Object requests/day; 13,000 GB-s compute/day; up to 5 GB SQLite-backed storage/account
watch_out: Workers Free supports only SQLite-backed objects; operations fail when daily quotas are exceeded; Workers request limits apply separately.

name: CircleCI Free
free_limit: 30,000 credits/month; up to 5 active users; 1 GB network transfer and 2 GB-month storage
watch_out: Free credits expire monthly and do not roll over; resource classes consume credits at different rates; personal builds stop when credits reach zero.

name: Val Town Free
free_limit: 100,000 runs/day; unlimited public vals; 2,500 vals; cron schedules as often as every 15 minutes
watch_out: New vals on Free are public; no custom domains; 1-minute execution timeout and 3-day log retention.

name: SimpleQ Free
free_limit: 30,000 outbound webhook attempts/month; 5 queues; up to 5 attempts/job; 3-day job retention
watch_out: Each dispatched webhook POST, including retries and backpressure responses, counts as an attempt; backpressure waiting is free. Commercial-use terms need confirmation.
